positive_text:

The room was very clean, well organised and comfortable, and everything was exactly as we expected. The Wi-Fi worked perfectly throughout our stay, and the access system with the entry code was very simple, convenient and made everything feel easy and secure.

A special thank you to Alona and Julie, who were absolutely amazing and so friendly! Even though the reception process was virtual when we arrived, they assisted us through the computer with the check-in and made the whole experience incredibly smooth. Everything was explained clearly, communication was excellent, and the process was quick and straightforward with no unnecessary complications or bureaucracy. We really appreciated how helpful, patient and welcoming they were.

The location is also very convenient. It’s easy to get around using public transport, and being close to Allianz stadium and Bondi Beach is definitely a big plus, especially if you want to explore one of Sydney’s most popular areas.

Overall, we really enjoyed the practicality of the hotel, the cleanliness, the location and especially the excellent customer service. Everything worked perfectly from check-in to check-out.

Thank you again to Alona and Julie for making our stay even better. We would happily stay here again!

title: Not as advertised and poorly maintained.
negative_text:
Unfortunately, this hostel does not match the photos or description shown on Booking. The exterior and interior look significantly different from what is advertised, and the overall condition of the property is far below expectations.
There is also inconsistent information provided to guests. The document sent at check-in states that check-in is at 2:00pm, yet staff strictly enforce a 3:00pm check-in and explained that the document is “outdated.” If policies have changed, official documents provided to guests should be updated accordingly to avoid confusion.
Check-in is restricted due to “cleaning,” however, upon arrival, the room was clearly not properly cleaned. Floors were not vacuumed, trash was left behind, and during my three-night stay, the room was never cleaned. The document also states that bed sheets are changed daily unless requested otherwise and that rooms are cleaned every day. Neither of these services were provided.
On my last day, after previous guests checked out, I pointed out leftover trash to the cleaning staff. When I returned later that evening, the trash was still there. The only action taken was placing a new garbage bag.
There is only one bathroom per floor for approximately four or five rooms, resulting in constant queues. The bathroom was noisy, poorly maintained, and lacked basic amenities. Towels are not provided and cost $10 to rent, which is significantly higher than typical hostel rates.
Breakfast and dinner are advertised as included, but both are offered only within a very limited one-hour window, which is impractical given the number of guests. Dinner was extremely basic, with no beverages included. When water was requested, only tap water was offered. Considering the overall hygiene standards of the property, this was concerning.
There is no physical reception — communication is via a remote screen, and assistance was limited and inconsistent.

positive_text: Beds are great.My 6 beds room was big. However the floor shakes when someone walks around but definitely the most comfortable bed I've slept on in a hostel

The kitchen is full of fruit flies, the bathrooms are constantly wet, (but pressure and water temperature are good) kitchenware is poorly washed and the place is older and beaten up compared to what is shown on booking. Only 1 bathroom per floor in my building and some nights I had to go in the building next door (part of the hostel) to use the toilet. At checkout, I was out of the room early, but I had a few trips up and down the stairs to take my suitcase and backpacks and they changed the code to gate and room and it was a struggle to get my stuff. Just give a 20 minutes window?! We are leaving, Jezzzz. Food seems to be like a little buffet from the pictures but it isn't. I do not recommend it if you have allergies, it doesn't seem like the place who would be able to respect cross contamination and so on. Also with the condition of the kitchen, I didn't feel like eating there either. Bring some good earplugs cause the AC will scream if turned on.
There's no in person receptionist, just remotely through the screen.

If you're on a budget, it's fine, it's also close to the metro and it's easy to get there from the airport.
